name: discr_powerBasis_eq_prod''
statement: Fin pb.dim ≃ (L →ₐ[K] E)) : algebraMap K E (discr K pb.basis) = (-1) ^ (n * (n - 1) / 2) * ∏ i : Fin pb.dim, ∏ j ∈ Ioi i, (e j pb.gen - e i pb.gen) * (e i pb.gen - e j pb.gen)

name: discr_powerBasis_eq_norm
statement: discr K pb.basis = (-1) ^ (n * (n - 1) / 2) * norm K (aeval pb.gen (minpoly K pb.gen).derivative)
